headword: {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}

definitions.explanation: A loan or receivable that is unlikely to be repaid, typically because the borrower has defaulted or become insolvent. A key term in banking and finance.

examples.japanese: {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らんでいる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: The bank's bad debts are growing.

examples.japanese: ⟦バブル→バブル：11120_baburu⟧{崩壊後|ほうかいご}、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: After the bubble burst, many banks suffered from bad debt problems.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ (defective, bad) + ⟦{債権|さいけん}→債権：08870_saiken⟧ (claim, receivable, credit). A central concept in Japanese economic history, particularly during the post-bubble period of the 1990s when massive non-performing loans nearly collapsed the banking system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to dispose of bad debts
- {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: bad debt problem
- {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: non-performing loan ratio
- {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: write-off of bad debts

ETYMOLOGY:
The {不良債権|ふりょうさいけん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ was a defining issue of Japan's "⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{十年|じゅうねん}" (Lost Decade) in the 1990s. Banks had lent heavily during the bubble economy, and when land and stock prices collapsed, these loans became unrecoverable.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{債権|さいけん}→債権：08870_saiken⟧: claim, receivable — the right to collect a debt
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧: debt, liability — the obligation to repay
- {貸|か}し{倒|だお}れ: bad debt, uncollectible loan — a more colloquial term
